name: Deep serve to a target zone
summary: Serve past a cone line in the back third of the service box to push the receiver back.
setup: Cones in a line about 1.5 m inside the receiver's baseline, across the diagonal service box
Sets of 10 serves, alternating right and left boxes
Count: in and past the cones; in but short; faults
success_criterion: In a set of 10 serves: at least 7 land past the cone line and at most 1 is a fault
coach_rationale: (judgment) A deep serve keeps the receiver back and gives the serving side more time on the third shot, which supports winning rallies on serve (AN-01); keeping faults at 1 in 10 protects AN-05. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
